fig, axes = plt.subplots(2,3, figsize = (18,12))

if 'Gender' in df.columns:
    gender_counts = df['Gender'].value_counts()
    axes[0,0].pie(gender_counts.values, 
                   labels=gender_counts.index, 
                   autopct = '%1.1f%%',
                   colors=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'],
                   startangle=90, 
                   textprops={'fontsize': 12, 'fontweight':'bold'})
    axes[0,0].set_title('Gender Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

if 'Age' in df.columns:
    sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', kde=True, ax=axes[0,1], color='steelblue')
    axes[0,1].axvline(df['Age'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
                      linewidth=2, label=f"Mean: {df['Age'].median():.1f}")
    axes[0,1].axvline(df['Age'].median(), color='green', linestyle='--', 
                      linewidth=2, label=f"Median: {df['Age'].median():.1f}")
    axes[0,1].set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Age(Years)')
    axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
    axes[0,1].legend(fontsize=11)


if 'Salary' in df.columns:
    sns.histplot(data=df, x='Salary', kde=True , ax=axes[0,2], color='seagreen')
    axes[0,2].axvline(df['Salary'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
                      linewidth=2,label=f"Mean: {df['Salary'].median():.0f}")
    axes[0,2].axvline(df['Salary'].median(), color='green', linestyle='--', 
                      linewidth=2, label=f"Median: {df['Salary'].median():.0f}")
    axes[0,2].set_title('Salary Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[0,2].set_xlabel('Salary ($)')
    axes[0,2].set_ylabel('Frequency')
    axes[0,2].legend(fontsize=11)

if 'Age' in df.columns:
    box=axes[1,0].boxplot(df['Age'].dropna(), patch_artist=True)
    box['boxes'][0].set_facecolor('lightblue')
    box['medians'][0].set_color('red')
    box['medians'][0].set_linewidth(2)
    axes[1,0].set_title('Age Boxplot', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Age(Years)')
    axes[1,0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    stats_text= (f"Mean: {df['Age'].mean():.1f}\n"
                 f"Median: {df['Age'].median():.1f}\n"
                 f"Min: {df['Age'].min():.0f}\n"
                 f"Max: {df['Age'].max():.0f}")
    axes[1,0].text(1.1, df['Age'].median(), stats_text,
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.8))


if 'Salary' in df.columns:
    box=axes[1,1].boxplot(df['Salary'].dropna(), patch_artist=True)
    box['boxes'][0].set_facecolor('lightgreen')
    box['medians'][0].set_color('red')
    box['medians'][0].set_linewidth(2)
    axes[1,1].set_title('Salary Boxplot', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Salary ($)')
    axes[1,1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    stats_text= (f"Mean: {df['Salary'].mean():.1f}\n"
                 f"Median: {df['Salary'].median():.1f}\n"
                 f"Min: {df['Salary'].min():.0f}\n"
                 f"Max: {df['Salary'].max():.0f}")
    axes[1,1].text(1.1, df['Salary'].median(), stats_text,
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.8))    


if 'Age' in df.columns and 'Salary' in df.columns:
    scatter=axes[1,2].scatter(
        df['Age'], 
        df['Salary'],
        c=df['Purchase'] if 'Purchase' in df.columns else 'blue',
        cmap='coolwarm', 
        alpha=0.6, 
        s=50
    )
    axes[1,2].set_title('Age vs Salary', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1,2].set_xlabel('Age(Years)')
    axes[1,2].set_ylabel('Salary($)')
    axes[1,2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    if 'Purchase' in df.columns:
        plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[1,2], label='Purchase')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('Complete_EDA_2x3.png', dpi= 150, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix, classification_report
dt= DecisionTreeClassifier(
    criterion='gini',
    max_depth=5,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    random_state=42
)

dt.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_pred=dt.predict(X_test)
y_pred_proba=dt.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]
accuracy=accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
cm= confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)
print("="*60)
print("Decision Tree Model Performance")
print("="*60)
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy*100:.2f}%")
print(f"\n Confusion Matrix: ")
print(cm)
print(f"\n Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred,target_names=['No Purchase', 'Purchase']))

from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV
param_grid={
    'max_depth':[3,5,7,10,None],
    'min_samples_split':[2,5,10,20],
    'min_samples_leaf': [1,2,4,8],
    'criterion':['gini', 'entropy']  
}
grid_search=GridSearchCV(
    DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42),
    param_grid,
    cv=5,
    scoring='accuracy',
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=1
)
grid_search.fit(X_train,y_train)
print("="*60)
print("Best Hyperparameters")
print("="*60)
print(grid_search.best_params_)
print(f"\nBest CV Accuracy: {grid_search.best_score_*100:.2f}%")
best_dt= grid_search.best_estimator_
y_pred_best= best_dt.predict(X_test)
best_accuracy= accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_best)
print(f"Test Accuracy with Best Model: { best_accuracy*100:.2f}%")

Fitting 5 folds for each of 160 candidates, totalling 800 fits

from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, roc_auc_score
final_model=best_dt if 'best_dt' in locals () else dt
y_pred_proba = final_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]
roc_auc=roc_auc_score(y_test,y_pred_proba)
fpr, tpr, thresholds = roc_curve(y_test, y_pred_proba)
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f'Decision Tree(AUC= {roc_auc:.3f})', linewidth=2)
plt.plot([0,1],[0,1],'k--',label='Random Classifier', linewidth= 1)
plt.xlabel('False Positive Rate', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('True Positive Rate', fontsize=12)
plt.title ('ROC curve- Purchase Prediction', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('ROC_Curve.png', dpi=150)
plt.show()
